user.title: Sign in to Rocco
user.description: Enter the email address you use with the Rocco app. Rocco will email you a sign-in code.

error.unknown_email: No Rocco account uses that email.
error.invalid_email: That doesn't look like an email address.
error.code_expired: That code has expired. Go back and request a new one.

abort.already_configured: This Rocco account is already set up.
abort.unique_id_mismatch: That email belongs to a different Rocco account.

init.title: Live updates
init.description: Get live door, temperature and status updates. Try automatic setup first. If that doesn't work for your account, you can paste an ID from the Rocco app instead.

menu_options.manual: Paste an ID from the Rocco app

manual.title: Paste an ID from the Rocco app
manual.description: Capture the Rocco app with Proxyman (Network Extension mode), open the request to cognito-identity.us-east-1.amazonaws.com, and copy the IdentityId from its body. It looks like us-east-1:12345678-abcd-…. Treat it like a password. Leave empty to turn live updates off.

error.automatic_failed: Automatic setup couldn't reach Rocco's AWS service. Try pasting an ID instead.
error.automatic_unavailable: Automatic setup isn't available for this account yet. Paste an ID from the Rocco app instead.
error.invalid_identity: That doesn't look like an identity ID. It should look like us-east-1:12345678-abcd-….
error.identity_rejected: Rocco's AWS service rejected that identity, or it can't see this fridge.
